[RB-BAD-CHANGE#02] Bad change and configuration regression > Signature in the data: A change record. In the change log, a `config_push` or `parameter_tuning` row on an aggregation router (which affects every site below it) or on each site of a group. Its status later reads `rolled_back`. The description can be bland, such as "scheduled parameter optimisation batch", so do not judge it by its wording. A step at the change time. ... What stays normal. ... Alarms. ...
[RB-RAN-UPGRADE-REGRESSION#02] RAN software upgrade regression > Signature in the data: A software upgrade change on a site or group of sites, executed at night. A short availability dip during the restart is expected, typically one or two steps. Persistent quality loss after the restart. Elevated `drop_rate_pct`, lower `rrc_success_pct`, and sometimes a lower volume that does not recover on the following days. ... Version-specific. ... Repeated restarts. ... Alarms. ...
[RB-BAD-CHANGE#05] Bad change and configuration regression > Verification steps: 1. `get_anomalies` for `rrc_success_pct` and `drop_rate_pct` on a set of sites; read the start time. 2. `get_topology`: find the common ancestor of the affected sites (aggregation router or link). 3. `get_changes` for that node and its sites in the 24 hours before the onset. ... 4. `query_kpis`: confirm availability is 100 % and the RRC step is aligned with the change. ... 5. ...
[RB-KPI-REFERENCE#02] KPI reference > Cell KPIs: One row per cell per 15-minute step in `cell_kpis`. A site has three cells, so site values are aggregates. `dl_volume_mb`, `ul_volume_mb`: data delivered in the step, in megabytes. Uplink is about 12 to 18 percent of downlink. Sum these over cells to get a site or region. ... Sum over cells. ... Latency and drop rate begin to rise when it passes about 80 to 85 percent. ... N...

result.markdown:
# RRC Success Rate Degradation in Sfax Sites

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SFX-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of the parameter tuning change on AGG-SFX-01 matching the exact onset of the KPI degradation across downstream sites, supported by detector alerts and matching runbook signatures. External events were NOT CHECKED via tool call.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-03 09:00 to 2026-09-03 10:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-03 09:02
- **Affected:** S-SFX-001, S-SFX-004, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007, S-SFX-008

## Summary

A scheduled parameter optimisation batch RT-2.5 applied to aggregation router AGG-SFX-01 caused RRC success rate degradation across downstream sites.

RRC success rate fell across 10 series (5 sites) in Sfax starting at 2026-09-03 09:00, recovering after the rollback of the parameter change.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-03 09:00: Earliest onset of RRC success rate deviation below baseline on S-SFX-001 and related Sfax sites. [T6, ALR-0005]
- 2026-09-03 09:02: Parameter optimisation batch RT-2.5 applied to aggregation router AGG-SFX-01 (CHG-2026-0008). [CHG-2026-0008]

## Evidence

- RRC success rate and drop rate anomalies occurred across Sfax sites S-SFX-001, S-SFX-004, S-SFX-005, S-SFX-007, and S-SFX-008 starting at 2026-09-03 09:00. [T1, T6, ALR-0005]
- A parameter tuning change was executed on aggregation router AGG-SFX-01 at 2026-09-03 09:02 and subsequently rolled back. [T5, CHG-2026-0008]
- No site-level alarms or maintenance windows were active on the affected Sfax sites during the incident window. [T2, T4]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-01: confirmed. Parameter tuning on AGG-SFX-01 precisely correlates in time with the multi-site RRC degradation on its downstream nodes, matching RB-BAD-CHANGE#02 and #05 signatures. [T5, CHG-2026-0008, RB-BAD-CHANGE#02, RB-BAD-CHANGE#05]
2. **bad_change** at S-SFX-005: rejected. Software upgrade CHG-2026-0007 occurred at 07:39, which does not match the 09:00 KPI degradation onset across all 5 sites. [CHG-2026-0007, T6]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0007: Minor firmware patch on S-SFX-005 occurred at 07:39, which precedes the 09:00 widespread multi-site KPI degradation onset.
- ALR-0006: Alert concerning latency_ms on S-SFX-010 at 21:00 is outside the scope and timeframe of the morning Sfax incident.

## Recommended actions

- Review parameter optimisation batch templates before applying them to aggregation routers.
- Verify pre-change and post-change metrics during configuration pushes.
